svg.title: BFS vs DFS traversal on undirected graph
svg.desc: Graph with 6 nodes A through F, showing BFS and DFS traversal orders side by side
svg.text: Edges: A-B, A-C, B-D, B-E, C-E, C-F
Dequeue A → enqueue B, C → visit B, C
Dequeue B → enqueue D, E → visit D, E
Dequeue C → E visited, enqueue F → visit F
Order: A → B → C → D → E → F
Start A → go deep → visit B
From B → go deep → visit D
Backtrack → visit E → backtrack to A
From A → visit C → visit F
Order: A → B → D → E → C → F
BFS: shortest path in unweighted graph
